'''Pantoran''' was the native language of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] species from [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]. It comprised many dialects that prevented clear communication, a vestige of the feudal culture of the planet's past. Because of the difficulties of operating a planetary government with so many different languages, the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Assembly]] established [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] as the official language of their people as a means of unifying the planet. Because of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|pro-Republic]] curriculum which continued even after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Pantoran was gradually becoming unfashionable.<ref name="EV" />

While Basic was spoken far more than Pantoran, distinct regional accents continued to flavor the spoken Basic of many Pantorans. Many Pantorans chose to educate their children in a trade language in addition to Basic, such as [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="EV" />
